bots._comment: botId must match the Azure Bot registration app ID and the id field above

composeExtensions._settingsComment: canUpdateConfiguration enables the Settings gear icon. Teams dispatches composeExtension/querySettingUrl to fetch the settings URL, then composeExtension/setting when the user saves. Handle both via InvokeHandler.

commands._comment: Search command — dispatched as composeExtension/query. The commandId arrives in InvokeRequest.value().getString('commandId')
commands.title: Search items

commands._comment: Action command — dispatched as composeExtension/fetchTask (to show form) then composeExtension/submitAction (on submit). Set fetchTask to true to show an Adaptive Card form before submission
commands.title: Create item
commands.description: Create a new item via a form

messageHandlers._comment: Link unfurling — dispatched as composeExtension/queryLink when a user pastes a URL matching these domains
